queue.progress: R01 separated atmosphere truth/state from evaluator policy using current UE 5.8, SideFX Karma, Hillaire 2020, Bruneton 2017, and Wilkie et al. 2021. R02 extended the candidate from lower-atmosphere rendering to a continuous ground-to-space semantics: NASA layer references and Karman-line clarification, current NASA CCMC NRLMSIS 2.0/2.1 whole-atmosphere state references, thermosphere/ionosphere physics-model boundaries, and HITRAN-backed spectral-reference semantics.
